description: Hi, I’m Prakruti, an MS Information Systems student at Northeastern with 7+ years in marketing and storytelling. Wish You Were Here turns the machines NASA left on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space into pen pals for kids: tap a pin, read a postcard in the machine’s own voice, learn what it discovered, then write back. Building solo, but open to anyone who loves design, space history or storytelling.
